title: Best version of '3d-asset-specification-database': The Signature 3D Asset Specification Database Database
body: Best version of the database subject '3d-asset-specification-database': The Signature 3D Asset Specification Database Database (3d-asset-specification-database-signature), holding 25 records. Why: BEST-VERSION RULE (deterministic, applied identically to every record): 1) the edition / file variant with the highest record_count (or, for files, the greatest byte size, i.e. the most complete variant) wins; 2) tie-break: the Signature edition wins over the public edition (for files: the manifest-declared local_index file wins); 3) final tie-break: alphabetical slug (or filename) order. Losing editions/variants are named with their counts on every record. Recompute: compare the figures on the record with the manifest; the rule above reproduces the verdict. Competing editions considered (2): The Signature 3D Asset Specification Database Database with 25 records [Signature]; The 3D Asset Specification Database Database with 25 records. The winning edition is the most complete version of this subject in the system; the others remain available as alternate editions.
